note: Extract of opus55_final_audit_tic4206066/10_novelty_protocol/protocol_recount.json (sha256 in 12_facts/EXCLUDED_FILES.csv). Only the shortlist rule, the MES ladder counts at 10/12/15 (quoted in FINAL_FACTS DATA.search.shortlist) and the two target rows.
detrend: wotan time-windowed biweight (Hippke et al. 2019, AJ 158, 143)
detection_statistic: MES = signal-to-pink-noise ratio, identical definition to leo_vetter get_SES_MES (Hartman & Bakos 2016 red noise, Pont et al. 2006)
vetting: leo-vetter 1.2.0 flux-level metrics (Kunimoto et al. 2025, AJ; https://github.com/mkunimoto/LEO-vetter), default thresholds
shortlist_rule: hard rejects always apply. Only if survivors > target_max: tier_A = keep signals passing all 13 LEO false-alarm (signal-quality) tests; then, if still > target_max, the lowest MES threshold from mes_ladder giving <= target_max. Never lowered when < target_min. No scientific-value or visual ranking.
